channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dwyane Wade | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dwyane Wade from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Allen Iverson on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Jeff Teague says Dwyane Wade IS NOT better than Allen Iverson:

“Y’all think D Wade better than Iverson? I ain’t. No disrespect to D Wade but I didn’t count Iverson as a 2 guard. If you put him as a 2 guard, nah. D Wade wanted to be Iverson”

Allen Iverson on Dwyane Wade, Aug 26, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Dwyane Wade, Anthony Davis, Trae Young
item.description:
AJ Dybantsa:

“The Wizards haven't been to the playoffs in some time, so I just want to make the playoffs year one. I think we have the team to do it, getting Anthony Davis, getting Trae Young and having our young core. But ultimate goal is I'll start getting D-Wade, I always wanted to be a Hall of Famer, but he says the goal I should have is to be a top 100 player. So I think 20 years from now, I answer the league 20 years from now, it will be the 100-year anniversary of the NBA. And you know, like top 75, they bring the 75 best players, I always says when they bring the 100 players out, that should be my goal instead of just being a Hall of Famer.”

AJ Dybantsa on Dwyane Wade, Anthony Davis, Trae Young, Jun 29, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Heat Central:Lonzo Ball believes Prime Dwyane Wade is about EVEN with prime Kobe Bryant:

“I got D Wade at 3. Right behind Kobe. And it ain’t far. I’ll die on that hill. D Wade is giving Kobe some fits. And MJ. They’re better, but it ain’t no walk in the park. Not a prime D Wade, no. It’s even to me. Kobe’s better but it ain’t clear. Out of 10 days, he’s not getting the better of him all 10 days. I got 6-4… He has one of the best rings ever. Year 3, to take a team and be the man and get that sh*t done? I commend that.”

Kobe Bryant on Dwyane Wade, Jun 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
h No He Didn't: Ant on going for blocks:

“I just be watching Dwyane Wade clips. He would beat shit at the rim so I just be trying to beat shit at the rim that's all. If Rudy ain't down there, I'm trying to beat that shit. I don't care who it is”

Anthony Edwards on Dwyane Wade, Apr 21, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Dwyane Wade, Patrick Beverley
item.description:
Draymond Green on the Dwyane Wade, Patrick Beverley:

“D-Wade comes back and he’s like, I don’t understand why Patrick Beverley would say anything like that you ain’t good enough to talk about me. I like how D-Wade popped his sh*t, I respect it I’m not getting in the middle of those two brothers. You know, that’s a Chicago thing you let them do there thing. But, I will say Pat Bev coming out and throwing that three point percentage out, was hilarious. Well Pat Bev the defense was guarding y’all a lil bit different brotha.”

Draymond Green on Dwyane Wade, Patrick Beverley, Mar 31, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Stan Van Gundy on when he knew Dwyane Wade would be special his rookie year:

“I was coaching our summer league team and we had Dwyane playing the point, which wasn’t his normal position, he actually played it his rookie year. Spo and I were one game into summer league and we were like ‘wow this guy even better than we thought.’What hit us was his poise and intelligence. Dwyane more than anybody I’ve ever been around had the ability to add something to his game like immediately. Spo would work with him on something in practice one day and Dwyane would do it for like an hour then you’d see it full speed in the game”

Stan Van Gundy on Dwyane Wade, Feb 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Micky Arison on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“Dwyane, thank you for the three rings and for giving us so many unforgettable moments,”

Micky Arison on Dwyane Wade, Sep 6, 2025. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Norman Powell on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“Taking moves and different things from [Dwyane Wade] and implementing it into my game and talking to him and seeing how he watches my game and knows my game and is proud of me and what I’ve been able to accomplish and that he was a motivating factor in my basketball career,”

Norman Powell on Dwyane Wade, Jul 10, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Shaq and Wade led the Heat to an NBA title against Dirk Nowitzki and the Dallas Mavericks in 2006.O'Neal recently joined The OGs podcast with Udonis Haslem and Mike Miller, revealing his conversation with Wade about his falling out with Bryant in LA.

“First thing I did when I came to Miami, I said, ‘Look, you heard a lot of s*** about me. That ain't going to happen with me and you. This is your [team]. I'm a help you; I'm a graduate, and I don't want them to call this no Shaq vs D-Wade,”

Shaquille O'Neal on Dwyane Wade, Sep 18, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“When I first got to Miami, I said to D-Wade, ‘You heard a lot of stuff about me, but that’s not going to happen here. This is your team. I’m here to help you get a championship.’I didn’t want the same issues I had with Kobe. I told Wade, ‘I came here because of you, and I need your help to get one more ring.’ We never had a problem. When we went down 0-2 in the Finals, we jumped on him. We said, ‘No, don’t look for us. You go to work.’ And he did. He took over the next four games and led us to the championship. That’s the difference between Wade and others. He had it from the beginning, and I respected him for it.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Dwyane Wade, Sep 17, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Vince Carter, Dwyane Wade, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, James Harden
item.description:
Gilbert Arenas:

“If we really want to have this discussion about Jordan’s competition, just look at the top five shooting guards in history. He didn’t play against any of them in their prime. Kobe’s number two, but he had a young Kobe in ’98. Then you have Allen Iverson, Dwyane Wade, James Harden, Tracy McGrady, Vince Carter—Jordan didn’t face these guys. History is showing you who’s who now because time has gone by.”

Gilbert Arenas on Vince Carter, Dwyane Wade, Michael Jordan, Allen Iverson, Tracy McGrady, James Harden, Aug 28, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Udonis Haslem
item.description:
Hassan Whiteside:

“One of the best memories I have from my time in Miami was meeting guys like D-Wade, Chris Bosh, and Udonis Haslem. When I first got to the Heat, I was getting suspended, getting into fights, and Bosh was always in my ear, telling me,‘Hassan, you worked all this time to get here. Why are you throwing it away?’ He was one of the people who really helped me get my head straight.”

Hassan Whiteside on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Udonis Haslem, Aug 27, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Udonis Haslem:

“I think whatever reason, that didn’t work. I don’t know if the dynamics with him and Dwyane would have worked at that time. So I don’t think dynamically, it didn’t work, but my ass was almost out of here.”

Udonis Haslem on Dwyane Wade, Jun 4, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Delon Wright on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Delon Wright:

“I wish I was here earlier in my career. Watching my brother, watching D-Wade.”

Delon Wright on Dwyane Wade, Feb 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“If that’s what it takes, I mean, I am willing to do it, but nah, I’m never cool with that. …He said Dwyane Wade came off the bench when Kobe played. I was like, all right, we don’t have a Kobe, but all right. But it was cool.”

Anthony Edwards on Dwyane Wade, Aug 24, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Dwyane Wade, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra said of the Timberwolves star.

“It’s hard not to look at Anthony Edwards and not see Dwyane Wade in him. And I’m not a guy for comparisons. But the way he moves, the way he competes, the way he electrifies a crowd, that reminds me of No. 3. I have told Anthony that, and I feel like I’m going back in time.”

Erik Spoelstra on Dwyane Wade, Anthony Edwards, Aug 23, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade
item.description:
That pie in the sky idea wasn’t so far-fetched, the former NBA MVP told a German magazine recently.

“It would already have to be an unbelievable situation to go somewhere, for instance with LeBron or Wade just to play in Miami,”

Dirk Nowitzki on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Aug 14, 2023. Source: NBC Miami.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“A lot of players retire and they want to go off and be private. They’re not interested in the spotlight anymore. They’ve had it for 10, 15, 20 years and they just want to go off, live their life, be quiet, stay out of the news. There’s a lot of people like that. “When you’re in front of that camera and in front of the media and now social media your whole life, Dwyane knows how to handle all these situations. So what he’s done post-career is just an incredible achievement on his part. And it’s not going to end. He’s just going to keep getting bigger and better, and he’s going to find his perfect niche, if he hasn’t already, somewhere. It’s just that growth.”

Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Aug 9, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“As a Heat player, Dwyane is the greatest player who ever put on a uniform for us,”

Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Aug 8, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“I just think the players today, like Dwyane, are very appreciative as they look back on their career and say I was in a good place in Miami and we helped each other get to where we wanted to get to – world champions, Hall of Fame. “I love him to death. Every time I see him, we wrap each other up in a big embrace and we talk. We talk about a lot of different things. He’s a great friend just like Magic [Johnson] is a great friend, like Zo (Mourning] is a great friend. He’s really an incredible guy, incredible man.”

Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Aug 8, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Caron Butler on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“I was like, ‘I actually have.’ I mentor a lot of people, a lot of individuals come out to our house. D-Wade (Dwyane Wade), we’re all friends, we bounce ideas off each other business wise, strategizing and doing all those things. “And over the course of the years, the amount of people that I’ve given information to, I was just like: ‘Man, I can be on the bench on a staff in a locker room doing all those things and really moving the needle in real time in their process.’ I’m just glad that I pivoted and came to the Heat organization.”

Caron Butler on Dwyane Wade, Jul 16, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Jimmy Butler on fitting in so well with the Heat:

“I’ve gotta give a shout-out to D-Wade. He always told me about this culture and how I fit here.”

Jimmy Butler on Dwyane Wade, May 31, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Jimmy Butler:

“Maybe I’ll hit a game-winner like @DwyaneWade, I think that would be really good. I’m not standing on any tables, but it’d be really cool to be D-Wade for a day.”

Jimmy Butler on Dwyane Wade, May 31, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Brady Hawk:Jimmy Butler on Dwyane Wade:

“He’s constantly in my ear. Half the time it’s not even about basketball, it’s about family.”

Jimmy Butler on Dwyane Wade, Mar 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @BradyHawk305.

item.title: Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Alonzo Mourning, Bam Adebayo
item.description:
Riley told the Miami Herlad.

“I go back to [Alonzo Mourning] and Zo was a franchise face and then Dwyane [Wade] along with Udonis [Haslem], andnow I look at Bam Adebayo the same way because of longevity. I see Bam here, I hope, for his whole career.”

Pat Riley on Dwyane Wade, Alonzo Mourning, Bam Adebayo, Feb 17, 2023. Source: Heat Nation.

item.title: Joakim Noah on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Noah said of the 2010 free agency frenzy.

“… Chis Bosh basically told me, ‘Yo, I’m coming to Chicago.’ If Chris Bosh came to Chicago…“I tried to recruit all of them. It didn’t matter. Whatever it took to get the Bulls better, I was doing. Derrick (Rose) wasn’t doing none of that s–t. I was doing all of that. People don’t know that, but yes, I did try to recruit LeBron. Yes, I did try to recruit D-Wade.”

Joakim Noah on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Nov 8, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Rich Kleiman on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Las Vegas
item.description:
Kleiman praised LeBron James as a trailblazer and said he and Durant have already put feelers out there.

“I think if LeBron is able to get into Vegas and then you see D-Wade in Utah, I think that only probably opens up the runway even moreso for Kevin having an opportunity to do that,”

Rich Kleiman on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Las Vegas, Nov 7, 2022. Source: Insider.com.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“That’s when I had to give everything to D-Wade (Dwyane Wade), like, ‘I don’t have it.’Tom’s going through a tough time right now. It has nothing to do with his age or football, but when you’re dealing with that real-life stuff, it takes a lot. … I know he’s going through a lot. I don’t know his situation, but I wish him well, and hopefully they can reconcile and get back together.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Dwyane Wade, Oct 29, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Ante Zizic on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“I spent three amazing seasons with the Cleveland Cavaliers. In my first season, we made it all the way to the Finals. I played with some big names like LeBron [James]. Dwyane Wade. Both superstars, future Hall of Famers. We won the Eastern Conference Finals and went to the NBA Finals. Huge. For my first year in the NBA, that was amazing,”

Ante Zizic on LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, Sep 29, 2022. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Spoelstra said:

“It is actually a good comparison because if you get in those pressure moments and the moments of truth, if you’re on the other side, would you ever, like, want to just give Dwyane Wade an open 3? You would not because he’s a killer. Like, he’s gonna, like, seize that moment. Jimmy has a lot of those same qualities.”

Erik Spoelstra on Dwyane Wade, Apr 20, 2022. Source: The Athletic.
